definitions.explanation: Not often; used with negative verb forms to indicate that something happens infrequently.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{滅多|めった}に{怒|おこ}らない。
こんな{機会|きかい}は{滅多|めった}にない。
{滅多|めった}に{外食|がいしょく}しない。

notes:
USAGE: {滅多|めった}に is almost always used with negative verbs (〜ない) to express rarity.

GRAMMAR PATTERN:
・{滅多|めった}に + negative verb (rarely does ~)
・{滅多|めった}にない (is rare, seldom occurs)

CONTRAST:
・{滅多|めった}に〜ない - rarely (strong emphasis on rarity)
・あまり〜ない - not very often (milder)
・ほとんど〜ない - hardly ever (even stronger)
・たまに - occasionally (opposite sense, without negative)
